seed: The menu under the Photonz icon in the menu bar starts the way File does at Next defaults, with no switch changed (the user, 2026-10-22: 'new menu items should be at the top on the menu like every other app in the world. capture can be a secondary section'). New, New from Clipboard, Open and Open Recent first, with File's keys; then the capture rows as their own section with their own keys; then updates, Welcome, Settings, Experiments, About and notices; then Quit. Read inside the app, so nothing opens on screen. Then a picture is opened, saved as a project and closed, and picking it from the icon's Open Recent reopens it in a window of its own, the same as File > Open Recent.
